label: Editorial
title: Five AI Short Drama Trends to Watch
excerpt: From the isekai-into-xianxia wave sweeping Chinese platforms to the alpha-werewolf romance boom on English-language apps like ReelShort, here's where the AI short-drama format is actually moving.
body: 1. Modern-world-into-mythology crossovers. A recurring setup on Chinese AI platforms drops an ordinary modern character into a xianxia or Journey-to-the-West-flavored world of immortals, demons and sword cultivation — AIMB's own Immortal Execution Platform — AI Live-Action Version, adapted from a 2025 web-comic IP, is a recent example that reportedly topped a platform AI-drama chart within days of release.

2. Two distinct visual lineages, not one "AI look." Chinese platforms are now publishing in at least two clearly different AI production styles side by side: a photoreal "真人" (live-action-style) look built to pass for traditional filmed drama, and a 2D "漫剧" (comic-drama) style that leans into stylization instead of hiding it. The Heart Inside the Steamed Bun is a comic-style example; Immortal Execution Platform and Feng Shui Master both aim for the live-action look.

3. English-language werewolf and alpha romance, concentrated on ReelShort. On the English-language side, the format that's scaling fastest isn't xianxia — it's shifter and fated-mate romance, with titles like Rejecting My Five Female Mates, The Alpha and His Nanny Luna and The Alpha Princess Is Gone for Good built around the same pack-hierarchy, forbidden-attraction formula repeated across dozens of near-identical titles.

4. Compressed production cycles. Where a traditionally filmed microdrama season can take months to shoot and edit, several of the Chinese AI titles above went from announcement to tens of millions of views within days of release — a timeline platform and trade coverage attributes directly to AI generation replacing physical production, not just speeding up post.

5. Platforms now track AI drama as its own category. Hongguo's standalone AI-drama chart — separate from its general short-drama rankings — is itself a trend: it signals that platforms see AI-generated short drama as a distinct content vertical worth measuring on its own terms, not a subset of the wider short-drama catalog. Expect more platforms to follow with their own AI-specific rankings as the format keeps growing.
